description: This file implements a screen recording service using macOS's ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation. It manages screen capture streams, handles potential errors, and writes video/audio to a file.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Main class providing the screen recording functionality, managing the overall process, error handling, and configuration.

classes.name: StreamRecorder
classes.description: Helper class managing the AVAssetWriter instance, capturing video/audio sample buffers, and finalizing the recording.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Performs screen recording for a specified duration, screen index, and optional audio, returning the path to the saved video and audio presence.

methods.name: stream(_:didStopWithError:)
methods.description: Handles errors when the stream stops unexpectedly.

methods.name: stream(_:didOutputSampleBuffer:of:)
methods.description: Processes incoming sample buffers (video or audio) and forwards them for writing.

methods.name: finish()
methods.description: Finalizes the recording, ensuring all data is written and resources are released.
